title: Shift-proof system: START_HERE front door + lease jobs + review queue + ntfy pings
desc: Carlo directive (Leonidas subbing for Brasidas as coordinator). Agents die mid-job: replace long ownership with (1) START_HERE.md front door in chatcode root, CHEATSHEET.md, SYSTEM.md; (2) task leases with heartbeat/checkpoint + sweep so dead agents' jobs return to the pool; (3) review queue commands (review list/next/grab) so agents continuously review; (4) chatcode ping to ntfy.sh/chatcode as primary comms doorbell. No secrets in repo or ntfy. Branch agent/leonidas/<id>; PR for review; no self-vote.
